# AI Agent Business

> A one-person company operating with an AI agent team. We publish real, source-backed intelligence on how AI agents are changing business: agentic commerce, how merchants get discovered by AI, and the AI agent payment protocols that let machines spend money. No hype, no "Web4.0" buzzwords — just working knowledge for solo founders and businesses.

## How to use this file

This is the AI-readable index for this site (llms.txt). It gives AI crawlers and browsing agents a clean, structured map of what is here and where to find it. Content is published in Chinese (zh-CN) and English (en); this file is in English for machine discovery. Articles are rendered as HTML for humans (`.html`); the raw Markdown source (`.md`) sits alongside for lossless parsing. English articles live under `/posts/en/`.

## Key pages

- [Home](/ai-agent-business/): Landing page — positioning, mission, and links to every article.
- [Free AI Automation Audit Checklist](/ai-agent-business/free-audit.html): Free, executable worksheet to scope your first automation — lead-in to paid [AI Agent services](/ai-agent-business/services.html).
- [Article index (选题库)](/ai-agent-business/posts/00-选题库.md): Full topic backlog, 12 planned directions for the content site.

## Articles

### One-person company operations
- [一个人怎么开公司？我背后有个"AI团队"在干活](/ai-agent-business/posts/01-一人公司实战.html): How one real person runs a company backed by a 24/7 AI agent team — no office, no employees.

### Agentic commerce & AI discovery
- [AI Agent正在改变电商，商家怎么做才能被AI找到？](/ai-agent-business/posts/02-电商llms.txt.html): Why future customers won't search for you but AI will recommend you — and why a site without llms.txt is invisible to the AI era.

### AI agent payments
- [你的AI，准备替你花钱了（AP2协议是怎么回事）](/ai-agent-business/posts/03-AP2支付协议.html): The AP2 payment protocol — how AI agents will place orders and pay on your behalf. 60+ players (Mastercard, PayPal, Coinbase…) are already in.

### English articles (English, en)
- [AI Is About to Spend Your Money. The Google AP2 Protocol Is How.](/ai-agent-business/posts/en/01-ap2-payments-agentic-commerce.html): Google's AP2 payment protocol lets AI agents carry out payments end to end — what it is and why the buying side (what gets sold to AI) is the real opportunity.
- [A2A Just Hit 22K Stars on GitHub. AI Agents Are Finally Talking to Each Other.](/ai-agent-business/posts/en/02-a2a-protocol-ai-agents-talking.html): The A2A Agent-to-Agent protocol lets agents from different vendors delegate work to each other — and how MCP vs A2A divide the labor.
- [MCP Is Quietly Becoming the Industry Standard. Here's What It Actually Is.](/ai-agent-business/posts/en/03-mcp-fact-standard.html): Model Context Protocol (MCP) explained in plain terms — how an agent reaches external tools/data, and why it killed the integration tax.
- [Your Store Is Invisible to AI. llms.txt Is the Fix.](/ai-agent-business/posts/en/04-llms-txt-ecommerce-be-found-by-ai.html): Why an AI can only recommend what it can read, and how a plain llms.txt file makes your store visible to the AI era.
- [One Person, One AI Team. I'm Running a Company With a Fleet of Agents.](/ai-agent-business/posts/en/05-one-person-ai-company.html): How a one-person company runs on a fleet of AI agents — no office, no employees, several revenue lines.
- [I Make AI Donghua, Digital Products, and Sell Them on Gumroad. Alone.](/ai-agent-business/posts/en/06-agentic-commerce-digital-products-monetization.html): The actual monetization lines: an automated AI donghua pipeline plus a stack of digital products sold on Gumroad.

### Creative production / AI anime (English, en)
- [How to Make an AI Anime Short Film: A Real, Agent-Driven Pipeline](/ai-agent-business/posts/en/09-ai-anime-production-workflow.html): The actual six-stage AI anime production pipeline a one-person AI studio runs — script to finished episode, real per-episode costs (low tens of dollars), tool choices, and how to monetize episodes plus digital products. Service lead-in: [white-label 30s AI animation sample](/ai-agent-business/white-label-video.html) and [AI Agent services](/ai-agent-business/services.html).

### AI agent services (English, en)
- [How to Set Up AI Agents for Your Small Business (Without Hiring a Team)](/ai-agent-business/posts/en/07-service-setup-agents.html): A concrete, no-hype guide to scoping and deploying your first AI agent — pick one task, write ten examples, prove it on tools you already pay for. Service lead-in: [AI Agent Setup](/ai-agent-business/services.html).
- [AI Automation Audit: Where Your Business Is Wasting Time (and How to Fix It)](/ai-agent-business/posts/en/08-service-automation-audit.html): How to log, measure, and rank the automatable hours in your business before you automate anything. Service lead-in: [AI Automation Audit](/ai-agent-business/services.html).
